description: This file defines client-side form logic for the 'Payment Term' doctype in the ERPNext system, including event handlers and dynamic description setting based on user input.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Event handler triggered when the form is loaded, which calls set_dynamic_description.

methods.name: discount
methods.description: Event handler triggered when the discount field is changed, which calls set_dynamic_description.

methods.name: discount_type
methods.description: Event handler triggered when the discount_type field is changed, which calls set_dynamic_description.

methods.name: set_dynamic_description
methods.description: Sets a descriptive text for the discount field based on its value and type.
